verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly publish a public filing or lookup API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents one. The pack describes only interactive, OHID-authenticated portal use and web tools on the Gateway and tax sites, and the probes show ohiosos.gov and the Ohio Business Central filing portal both returning 403 at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
